difficulty_reason: Reduces smoothness of g : V_{/Z} -> W to simultaneous smoothness of all truncations V_n -> W_n; reduces W to an affine formal scheme by algebraizing an etale neighbourhood; the key step builds the Rees algebras B' and A' of the b-adic fibres, shows the comparison Psi between them is an isomorphism after localizing at m_1, and concludes by a principal localization that Psi is an isomorphism, whence B_n -> A_n is flat with smooth fibres and therefore smooth.
